description: WP-W3: an army built in the real browser Army Builder reaches the game with the Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) datasheets, not the bundle's pre-codex ones. Game-side half of server/tests/e2e-codex-datasheets.mjs, which first drives the builder page (Playwright): faction Adeptus Custodes, Guardians of the Throne, a warlord Shield-Captain (the builder shows M8" T7 W8 and 205 pts = 180 + 25 for the default Praesidium Shield) and a Custodian Guard Sodality (3 models, W5, 240 pts), saved to the cloud as WPW3_E2E_Custodes on a local relay server (the driver points res://server_config.json at it for this run only). No fixture: the scenario runs on the MainMenu. A real click on Refresh Cloud Armies lists the army; it is selected for Player 1; a real click on Start Game downloads it and starts the game. In game the Shield-Captain has the codex profile (W8 on the unit and its model, T7, M8, 205 pts, the Praesidium Shield wargear ability) and the Sodality has 3 W5 models; the Shield-Captain's datasheet card shows W 8. Not runnable without that server (driver described in .llm/codex_11e_wahapedia/changelog/WP-W3.md).

steps.comment: the driver's temporary server_config.json points at the e2e relay server
Player 1 picks the cloud army in the dropdown; both seats human
steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
var idx := -1
for i in range(main.army_options.size()):
	if str(main.army_options[i].id) == "WPW3_E2E_Custodes":
		idx = i
main.player1_dropdown.select(idx)
main.player1_dropdown.item_selected.emit(idx)
main.player1_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player1_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
return main.player1_dropdown.get_item_text(main.player1_dropdown.selected).contains("Cloud")

steps.comment: the downloaded cloud army is the builder export: codex data_source
the Shield-Captain has the codex profile in game: W8 (unit and model; pre-codex W6), T7, M8, 205 pts with its Praesidium Shield
the Custodian Guard Sodality: 3 models, W5, 240 pts, no Vexilla (+1 OC) — the builder did not take one
screenshot framing only: the Battle Formations dialog (an exclusive popup) is hidden so the datasheet is readable; it is shown again after the screenshot
steps.script:
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd == null or not is_instance_valid(fd) or not fd.visible:
	return 0
fd.set_meta("_w3_hidden", true)
fd.hide()
return 1

steps.comment: open the Shield-Captain's datasheet (the I-key card)
the card's statline reads the codex values

steps.script:
tree.current_scene.get_node("DatasheetModal").close()
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd != null and is_instance_valid(fd) and fd.has_meta("_w3_hidden"):
	fd.remove_meta("_w3_hidden")
	fd.show()
return true
